summary: Restore the complete base-form pair and remove its tail from sense 1.
rationale: The batch splits the base-form pair after its opening parenthesis, putting alt. raʕi)/roʕe into the gloss. Both the stem note and the permitted full lookup preserve the complete pair and the separate sense weiden; abweiden.

summary: Restore the animals as the object of lagern lassen.
before: hatten sie sich lagern lassen, und ihre Tiere hatten
after: hatten sie ihre Tiere lagern lassen, und diese hatten
rationale: The Turoyo has maḥatte ... l-aḥ=ḥəyewən dəṯṯe, and the supplied edition explicitly says they had their animals camp there. The current reflexive sich makes the people the ones caused to camp.
